name: clipzyme_reactzyme_reaction_similarity_baseline_contract_v1

authoritative_external_baseline.name: CLIPZyme
authoritative_external_baseline.paper: CLIPZyme: Reaction-Conditioned Virtual Screening of Enzymes

tiger_reference.name: TIGER
tiger_reference.reason_not_selected: No official executable implementation or clean independent reproduction is available as of 2026-09-01.

baseline_native_inputs.reaction_encoder: official CLIPZyme aligned difference-graph encoder via extract_reaction_features
baseline_native_inputs.reaction_atom_mapping: RXNMapper is preprocessing only; no Catalyst reaction representation enters the baseline
baseline_native_inputs.protein_encoder: author CLIPZyme protein embedding, preferably the released clipzyme_screening_set.p; if author encoder is run, use only the author implementation/checkpoint and required structure/ESM inputs

support_freeze_rule.reaction_requirement: official CLIPZyme graph prerequisite after deterministic mapping: all atoms positively/uniquely mapped and reactant/product map sets identical
support_freeze_rule.protein_requirement: exact author screening-registry identifier or author-native protein inference support
support_freeze_rule.pair_support: intersection of the two author-input domains only

metrics.query_semantics: Report R2E and E2R separately on the exact common score matrix. Hit@K is any-positive-in-top-K; MRR is standard best-positive reciprocal rank unless an explicitly separate author-paper metric is named.

benchmark_reveal_state.role: descriptive authoritative-baseline alignment plus coverage/capability evidence

allowed_adaptation: RXNMapper atom mapping solely to satisfy CLIPZyme native input

asset_acquisition.status: needed_for_author_precomputed_protein_support; direct Zenodo access from nju-server-06 currently HTTP 403, so acquisition must remain provenance-preserving and checksum-verified
